What We Treat

Pests, Termites, Mosquitoes & Wildlife — Handled

From a yearly termite inspection to a squirrel in the attic, we take care of the pests that show up around Coweta County homes — and we do it at a fair price.

Termite Control

Termites do their damage quietly, in places you cannot see. Our yearly termite inspections catch them early, and our treatments protect your home for the long haul.

Watch forMud tubes on your foundation, piles of discarded wings, or wood that sounds hollow.

Pest Control

From ants to yellow jacket nests, we treat the everyday pests that show up in Coweta County homes — reliably, thoroughly, and at a reasonable price.

Watch forAnt trails in the kitchen, wasp nests under the eaves, or bugs where they do not belong.

Mosquito Control

Mosquitoes should not keep you off your own porch. Our mosquito treatments let you enjoy your yard again — mornings, evenings, and all summer long.

Watch forStanding water, shaded shrubs, and bites every time you step outside.

Wildlife Control

Bats, squirrels — you got it, and we catch it. We remove wildlife from your home safely and help keep it from coming back.

Watch forScratching in the attic, droppings, or animals getting in through the roofline.

We also treat all of these:

Ants Bed Bugs Yellow Jackets Bats Squirrels Spiders Roaches Fleas Mice Rats

Cora D.Customer — Coweta County

Coweta / Fayette Termite & Pest Control is owned and operated by David Holcombe, a lifelong resident of Coweta County. David graduated from Newnan High School in 1988, served in the US Navy and then the US Coast Guard, and worked at Orkin Pest Control until February 2000 — when he founded this company. He and his wife Rebecca, also a lifelong Coweta resident, have been married 28 years.
